hook: 28,000 reviewers say this $29.98 set ends counter clutter

scenes.visual_prompt: Open bags of flour, cereal boxes, and snack bags spilling across a counter
scenes.on_screen_text: This is what retail packaging does
scenes.voiceover: Open bags and boxes don't stack. That's half my counter clutter right there.

scenes.visual_prompt: Hand trying to stack two different cereal boxes, one tips over
scenes.voiceover: There was never a container that matched, so it just piled up.

scenes.visual_prompt: Unboxing the Vtopmart 24-piece Airtight Food Storage Container set
scenes.voiceover: This 24-piece set is $29.98, rated 4.7 stars across over 28,000 ratings - that's a big enough sample to trust the pattern.

scenes.visual_prompt: Pouring cereal and flour into the airtight containers
scenes.voiceover: The seal keeps cereal fresh, and the containers stack flush, which the bags never did.

scenes.visual_prompt: Wide shot of a pantry shelf with uniform containers stacked neatly, counter clear
scenes.voiceover: That stacking frees up pantry shelf space and the counter space the bags were overflowing onto.

scenes.visual_prompt: Close-up on a star rating and review count graphic overlay
scenes.voiceover: At almost 28,000 ratings, this isn't one person's opinion.

caption: The flour bag, the half-open cereal box, the snack bags still in retail packaging - that's not an appliance problem, it's a packaging problem. The Vtopmart 24-piece set is $29.98 and it's the highest-reviewed fix in a 5-product comparison I just ran: 28,028 ratings at 4.7 stars.
